matches: Ozzie’s facade remains on the right, with the large concentric heart entrance and readable OZZIE’S sign.

differences.detail: Aspect ratio and framing changed from 1920 × 1177 to approximately 16:9; facade size, storefront spacing and perspective were recomposed.
The lower fifth is a broad horizontal wet-paving strip; the source road instead continues strongly in depth toward the bottom edge.
Queue posts and velvet ropes visible outside the source entrance are absent from this background; a separate prop/layer remains to be checked.
Door/steps, facade curvature, lantern and column proportions differ; fine signage and distant storefront details are simplified or redrawn.
Surface reflections and saturation are stronger/more polished in places; this is an adapted redrawing, not a traced or pixel-identical production background.
Native PNG is 1672 × 941, below the 2560 × 1440 preference in the generation prompt; no upscaling or higher-resolution master is asserted.

assets.acceptanceReason: Recognizable reference-backed location, coherent clean static scene and clear horizontal lane; accepted as an adapted stage illustration with explicit fidelity limits.
remainingChecks: Review any separate velvet-rope layer against the entrance and source before delivery.
Check character contrast, ground baseline, cropping and parallax alignment in the running game.
